content: The federal funds rate stood at 3.63% in August 2026, unchanged from July. The rate has declined from 4.33% in January 2026, reflecting the Federal Reserve's easing cycle. The rate dropped below 4% in March 2026 when it reached 3.83%.

content: Under SEC Rule 206(4)-1, all marketing materials must be reviewed by a designated compliance officer prior to distribution. Advisers must retain copies of advertisements for a minimum of 5 years. The SEC examined 312 investment advisers for marketing rule compliance in 2024 and found deficiencies in 28% of examined firms. Penalties can reach up to $250,000 per violation.

Under SEC Rule 206(4)-1, all investment advisers must submit marketing materials to the SEC for pre-approval within 15 business days of first use. The rule mandates that AI-generated content carry a visible disclaimer label. In 2024, the SEC examined 500 advisers and found violations in 42% of firms, with average fines of $750,000 per violation.
